title: SDGDS Progressive Roadmap & Evaluation Baseline
procedure: PRE R0-R9 procedures applied using installed PRE skill set; specialist runtime invocations are not claimed.

authority.rule: PRE supplies roadmap and evidence; it does not authorize merge, release, security acceptance or production claims.

objective: Provide an evidence-backed, versioned, accurate and discoverable terminology system for HSMART and Hypersystem-Orchestrator, with GitHub as canonical source and Notion as synchronized knowledge and governance surface.
intended_outcomes: One stable identity and one canonical definition per concept.
Definitions understandable to technical and non-technical readers without losing precision.
Source provenance and review state visible for material claims.
Terminology changes discoverable and synchronized without duplicate records or silent drift.
Reduced lookup friction and cross-repository ambiguity, measured before outcome claims.
scope: HSMART and explicitly approved Hypersystem-Orchestrator documentation and contracts.
Canonical JSON registry, schema, validator, generated index, curation policy and CI.
Notion terminology registry and roadmap/evaluation ledger.
Future discovery, semantic relationships, search, monitoring and outcome measurement.
non_goals: Do not scan private plugin source or instruction repositories without explicit source allowlisting and rights review.
Do not auto-promote machine-generated candidates to Canonical.
Do not treat Notion as a competing canonical source.
Do not claim a deployed SDGDS API/MCP service or production infrastructure.
Do not claim expert endorsement without attributable primary evidence.

notion_registry.note: 25 records seeded; five source-reference updates were individually applied. Current full aggregate re-read unavailable due Notion workspace Query Data Source allowance.

baseline.main_branch_status: PR #28 is merged to main. PR #29 is not merged.
baseline.production_state: No deployed glossary runtime or autonomous discovery service evidenced.

progress_measurement.overall_completion_reason: No GOV-01-approved frozen work-item denominator or comparable weighting exists. A single percentage would be misleading.
progress_measurement.verification_coverage: 8/8 SDGDS unit tests and 5/5 workflow groups passed on exact PR #29 head.
progress_measurement.term_inventory_coverage: UNKNOWN; 25 is the seed count, not total ecosystem vocabulary.
progress_measurement.outcome_attainment: NOT_ASSESSED; user lookup, comprehension, onboarding and consistency baselines have not been measured.
progress_measurement.schedule_variance: NOT_COMPUTABLE; no approved schedule baseline or committed target dates.

pre_lifecycle.result: Intent, host mode, scope, decision need, authority and non-goals documented.
Current branch, PR, CI, Notion seed and missing dependencies reviewed; post-edit aggregate Notion re-read blocked by workspace query allowance.
Roadmap v0.1.0 and work-item ledger constructed; awaiting approval.
GOV-01 disposition required; PR #29 remains open.

No approved frozen milestone acceptance or post-merge evidence.
No user adoption or comprehension baseline/outcome evidence.
Prior iteration hardened provenance, validation and Notion retry/rate-limit behavior; no broader rebaseline justified yet.
Operational owner, sync proof, measured outcome and residual-risk disposition remain open.
